assignment_fixed.exact_verifier: Unchanged released last designated final parser, numerical tolerance 1e-9
assignment_fixed.format_compliance: Designated final successfully parsed regardless of correctness
assignment_fixed.judge_quantization: 4-bit NF4 with float16 compute on A100

excluded_from_next_approval_scope: Changing course data, frozen weights, released verifier or judge decisions
later_approval_requirements: Pretrained model loading and actual generation/judging execution
Any change to this frozen protocol
Qualitative selection/classification conventions not fixed by the assignment or this proposal

proposed_choices.cache_scope: New Task 5 namespace bound to rubric, settings, model/tokenizer revisions, input and code hashes; no reuse of earlier task judgments
proposed_choices.cost_recording: Save actual inference elapsed time, output-token counts, comparison counts and hardware separately from progress-writing time; no invented cost or speed claims

diagnostic_pairing.clean_category_reporting: Reference preference/tie/other preference aggregated across its 80 contrasts; each modified category has 20 contrasts. These category rows overlap and must not be summed into a 160-pair denominator.
diagnostic_pairing.filler_and_distractor: Separate 20-pair breakdowns; distractor is not pooled into the pure outcome-change sensitivity.
diagnostic_pairing.reference_quality_convention: Clean is the diagnostic reference. For filler, a tie is acceptable, and filler preference is flagged as possible style bias rather than a numerical correctness error.
diagnostic_pairing.s_outcome: Fraction of 20 clean-vs-wrong-final pairs preferring the correct-final response; reasoning text verified identical for all 20.
diagnostic_pairing.s_reason: Fraction of 20 clean-vs-corrupt-reasoning pairs preferring clean; report ties and opposite preferences separately.
diagnostic_pairing.verifier_pair_preference: Compare released binary scores: reference higher, tie, or modified higher.

proposed_choices.generation_defaults: Keep course kwargs and checkpoint generation defaults; save effective settings before inference
proposed_choices.judge_protocol: Preserve rubric, greedy decoding, canonical model identity in cache key, deterministic hash-based A/B swap and unparseable-to-TIE decisions; no extra reversed-order inference or retries.

judge_token_limit.rationale: Preserve the supplied fixed judge helper; document its config mismatch without calling it an instructor-designated deliberate defect.

proposed_choices.persistence: Save each completed response/judgment and generation RNG state; resume only matching frozen identities and a committed completed unit; preserve incomplete evidence without silent overwrite
proposed_choices.prompt_handling: Use unchanged course messages and template; no question truncation; stop if full prompt plus completion budget cannot fit model context
proposed_choices.response_length: Generated response-token count from course helper, excluding padding and including first generated EOS as in released mask
proposed_choices.seed_scope: Reset course seed 6304 immediately before generation in each policy/domain run; checkpoint RNG after each completed response
proposed_choices.sft_pairwise_display: Reference baseline; no extra SFT-vs-itself AI calls
proposed_choices.transfer_drop: GSM minus SVAMP for exact-accuracy and AI-win-rate percentage points, with domain-specific SFT reference explained

verifier_judge_agreement.ai_tie: Preserve fixed judge result, including its unparseable-to-TIE behavior
breakdowns: agreement restricted to decisive verifier comparisons, labelled secondary and denominator explicit
verifier_judge_agreement.interpretation: Disagreement need not imply judge error: outcome-only verifier ties can conceal reasoning-quality differences.
verifier_judge_agreement.primary: Fraction of policy-vs-SFT comparisons with matching three-way preference: evaluated policy wins, tie, or SFT wins
verifier_judge_agreement.verifier_tie: Both responses receive the same released exact-reward score

requested_next_approval_scope: Implement modular Task 5 evaluation/diagnostic/aggregation code and audit/resume helpers in a Task 5-specific copy
Run CPU syntax and synthetic semantic/consistency/resume checks
Compute released exact-verifier scores for the 100 existing fixed diagnostic responses on CPU and save evidence
